text: This candidate received an overall fit score of 0.50 for the Software Engineer position. Their strongest evidence is their experience with "Django" for the python requirement and "AWS" for the nice-to-have requirement. Key gaps include a lack of experience with database and containerisation technologies, as well as having 1.5 years of experience, which is below the implied 2-year threshold. Despite being below the scoring threshold, this application has been escalated for further review.
